applicability: Recorded assessment availability and currentness for new captures and previously sealed comparison manifests.
conditions: Owner-measured empty, unavailable and uncaptured collections remain distinct facts.
Absent optional availability or custody metadata contributes no field to older canonical encodings.
Uncaptured assessments retain not-selected/not-measured treatment; source measurability alone does not measure an absent collection.
exclusions: Retrofitting missing historical metadata or changing an existing seal.
Equating a missing capture with no prior authorship, measured absence or currentness.
statement: Captured assessment availability distinguishes measured-empty, unavailable and not-captured history. Missing optional availability metadata is canonically omitted so old sealed manifests keep their original identities; uncaptured assessments never become measured absence or a favorable currentness result.
